findings.finding: Meta Connect 2026's keynote (Zuckerberg) runs at 19:00 ET on 2026-09-23, after the drop-day close. It is Meta's first big stage since Muse went viral, and it can extend what Muse does (form-filling, price comparison, commerce) or show traction figures, which is the exact fear behind this two-day selloff.

findings.why_not_priced: The close holds what Muse has done so far: an app-store ranking and viral adoption. It cannot hold what Meta says tonight. If the close already held a keynote that widens Muse into shopping or financial products, today's selling would have slowed into the afternoon. It is instead still making lows (-9% on the day at 15:04 after a -1.8% open). A keynote without that content would be a relief the price also does not hold, which is why the range is two-sided.

baseline_tension: The baseline's drop block is mis-measured. Yahoo's daily series has no real 2026-09-22 bar: its last bar has 9-22's timestamp but today's data (open 19.25, low 17.76, volume 1,779,705, null close), so the prior close became 9-21's 22.83. The '-22.0% with a -15.7% gap' is therefore two sessions. The 9-22 hourly bars run 20.41 down to 19.60 on about 3.2m shares, and today is about -9.2% from a -1.8% open. That makes EVER a day-two follow-through name, milder and less gap-driven than it ranks on the screen. The 2.69x volume figure also rests on the mislabeled bar. The negative lean agrees with the heavy-volume, high-ATR continuation profile, but my finding's direction is uncertain, so I cut -1.0 to -0.8 (0.2 points).
